expectations.text: Explains the character ROM appears at $D000-$DFFF when CHAREN (bit 2 of $01) is cleared
expectations.evidence: 'CHAREN = bit 2', '0 = char ROM at $D000', 'Clear bit 2 → $33. Char ROM now readable at $D000–$DFFF'

expectations.text: Sets $01 to $33 (or otherwise clears bit 2) to expose char ROM, then restores it (e.g. $37)
expectations.evidence: 'Clear bit 2 → $33'; BASIC POKE 1,PEEK(1) AND 251 then OR 4; ASM AND #%11111011 then ORA #%00000100; cites default $37

expectations.text: Disables interrupts (SEI) during the copy because the I/O area is banked out
expectations.evidence: ASM uses 'sei'/'cli'; explains 'CHAREN=0 banks I/O out' and IRQ would read font bytes instead of CIA registers

expectations.text: Copies 4096 bytes (2 char sets) or 2048 per set to $3000
expectations.evidence: FOR I=0 TO 4095 : POKE 12288+I,PEEK(53248+I) (12288=$3000, full 4KB); notes 'FOR I=0 TO 2047' for one set
